ops.map.workHelp.title: Work mode
ops.map.workHelp.body:
Map markers and archive preview use the official time window. Primary count = linked to this crisis; secondary = total on map.

Solid = linked here · Amber ring = other crisis · Purple dashed = unlinked

Use the side buttons to draw zones and run archive.
ops.map.viewHint.all: All: every report in work-crisis zones and time
ops.map.viewHint.unspecified: Unlinked: in range, not archived to any crisis
ops.map.viewHint.crisis: Archived: only reports linked to this work crisis
ops.map.viewRules.crisis: Archived view: only reports linked to the work crisis. Use All for daily ops.
ops.map.viewRules.unspecified: Unspecified: reports not yet in any active crisis.
ops.map.viewRules.all: All: unspecified plus active crisis reports in your zone scope.
ops.map.viewHelp.title: How is the report count calculated?
ops.map.viewHelp.crisis:
[Archived] Only reports linked to the work crisis—use to verify archive results.

For zones, new reports, and archive runs, stay on All.
ops.map.viewHelp.unspecified: [Unlinked] In work-crisis zones and browse time, not linked to any active crisis.
ops.map.viewHelp.all:
[All] Every report in work-crisis zones and browse time (recommended default).

Solid = linked here · Amber ring = other crisis · Purple dashed = unlinked

Changing work crisis updates zone boundaries only; unlinked reports stay visible.
